build.name: configure + make the library
build.cmd: ./configure >/dev/null 2>&1 && make -s 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; test -f src/libck.a && echo built

build.name: build the spinlock / backoff / ring validation programs
build.cmd: for d in ck_spinlock ck_backoff ck_ring; do make -s -C regressions/$d/validate 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -2; done; ls regressions/ck_spinlock/validate | grep -v '\.' | head -20

runs.name: ticket spinlock under 4-way contention (validate: no lost update)

notes: Runs four of ck's own validation programs (they assert their invariants and exit non-zero on violation). The full regression suite is long; a subset is recorded.
